search.notes: No site URL pattern was confirmed, so search Google for the name on this domain and open the listing in a browser.

steps: Open the opt-out page, choose subject or authorized agent, and enter the name and email.
Open the emailed link within 24 hours.
Fill the form so it matches the record and submit.
optout.notes: The page says a result email follows within 45 days. The site's notice also offers phone opt-out at (855) 240-6392 and says to refresh the request from time to time. The old /removal path returns 404. Operated by Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC per the 2026 California registry, along with FastPeopleSearch, USPhonebook, SearchPeopleFree, SmartBackgroundChecks, CyberBackgroundChecks and AdvancedBackgroundChecks. Each site has its own opt-out.
